newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lancome plans global launch for night cream.
newsitem.headline: Lancome plans global launch for night cream.

text.p: Lancome, a subsidiary of French cosmetics group L'Oreal, will for the first time launch a new product simultaneously in several markets around the world, designed to build product awareness among women who are increasingly travelling more, Lancome officials told Reuters.

The launch of the new skincare product, a night cream called Primordiale Nuit, will be the company's first attempt to place a product in several markets at once, Lancome's marketing executive for skincare products said in a telephone interview on Friday.
"Women travel more and more. It is important at the time you launch a product that they hear of it everywhere in the world," said the executive, who asked not to be named.
Primordiale Nuit will be launched in Europe, the U.S. and Japan in September. Launches in the rest of Asia and in Latin America will follow up to early 1998, a Lancome spokesman said.

The launch will consist of an advertising campaign in women's magazines, a "truly massive" distribution of samples in magazines and beauty counters of shops, and shop window displays, the marketing executive said.
She declined to specify the budgets, but said advertising and samples were the most important.

The magazine adverts for Primordiale Nuit will show Lancome model Cristiana Reali asleep and awake after the cream has been regenerating her skin overnight. Most night cream adverts tend to show the model either asleep or awake, but rarely both, the marketing executive said.
Lancome, whose advertising is handled by French advertising group Publicis, has commissioned "gatefold" adverts, which the reader must open out to see the awakened Reali.
Lancome launched its first two Primordiale products, a cream and a lotion, at the end of 1995, and followed up with an eye contour cream, Primordiale Yeux, at the beginning of this year.
Primordiale cream sells nearly four million units worldwide, while Pimordiale Yeux has taken first place in France and the U.S. markets for eye contour creams, the marketing executive said.
"Primordiale Nuit is a product for which we have fairly major ambitions," she said. SLA
